admission.justification: Guarded by schema unit tests; prevents stale or mismatched upstream_commit snapshots, unknown keys, bool-as-int coercions and structural stage-map drift from entering downstream explainer builds undetected.

applicability: Validation of audit/provenance.json, audit/verification-status.json, dag/stage-map.json and dag/dag.json by src/rh_pipeline/validate/schemas.py::validate_repo_artifacts.
conditions: All four JSON artifacts are deserialized through Phase 0 and Phase 1 strict models enforcing exact keys, bool-rejected integers, pinned AUDIT_SCHEMA_VERSION, and load_stage_map structural invariants.
Cross-file upstream_commit consistency checks verification-status against provenance and dag against verification-status, falling back to provenance when verification-status is unavailable.
exclusions: Per-file deserialization stops at the first ValueError raised by a model parser; external memory repository docs/ artifacts are validated separately.
statement: validate_repo_artifacts strictly validates audit/provenance.json, audit/verification-status.json, dag/stage-map.json, and dag/dag.json against Phase 0 and Phase 1 models, rejecting missing files, malformed JSON, unknown keys, bool-as-int values, invalid stage-map structure, and upstream_commit mismatches across audit and DAG artifacts.
title: Strict audit and DAG artifact schema and commit-consistency gate
